title: On Measuring Semantic Preservation in Legal Ontology Learning
abstract: arXiv:2608.12326v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Ontology learning transforms unstructured text into structured representations for automated reasoning. Yet structuring information risks losing it, and current evaluation methodologies cannot detect such loss, focusing on structural correctness while failing to measure whether meaning survives transformation. We propose an evaluation methodology that addresses this: comparing LLM task performance on source documents against performance on transformed representations, with the difference quantifying semantic loss. We demonstrate this approach on legal merger agreement analysis, a domain chosen for its complex language and precise semantic requirements, comparing direct LLM application against three ontology learning methods across six language models. The results reveal systematic semantic loss with significant variation based on reasoning complexity and model-method interactions. Our contributions are: (1) an evaluation framework for me

translated_title: 法律本体学习中语义保持的度量研究
translated_abstract: 本体学习将非结构化文本转化为结构化表示，以支持自动化推理。然而，结构化信息的过程可能造成信息丢失，而当前的评估方法无法检测到这种丢失，它们侧重于结构正确性，却未能度量意义是否在转化过程中得以保留。我们提出了一种解决此问题的评估方法：比较大型语言模型在源文档上的任务表现与在转化后表示上的表现，其差异用于量化语义损失。我们在法律合并协议分析中展示了该方法，该领域因其复杂语言和精确语义要求而被选中，我们比较了直接应用大型语言模型与三种本体学习方法在六个语言模型上的效果。结果揭示了系统性的语义损失，且损失因推理复杂度和模型-方法交互作用而显著变化。我们的贡献包括：(1) 一个用于度量语义保持的评估框架。
tldr: 本文提出了一种通过比较大型语言模型在源文本与转化后表示上的任务表现来量化语义损失的评估方法，并在法律合并协议分析中验证了其有效性。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes an evaluation methodology that quantifies semantic loss by comparing LLM task performance on source documents versus transformed representations, validated in legal merger agreement analysis.
